Title: How much does it cost to paint baseboards per linear foot?
Description: The sources we read put hiring a painter at about $1.00 to $3.50 per linear foot (CountBricks, February 2026) up to $2.30 to $4.88 (Homewyse, May 2026). Detailed profiles, heavy prep and small jobs sit toward the high end. A typical bedroom has about 45 feet, so roughly $45 to $220 by our arithmetic. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does it cost to replace all the knobs and pulls in a kitchen?
Description: For about 32 openings, our arithmetic gives roughly $64–$128 for budget hardware, $160–$320 for mid-range and $480–$960 for premium, if you install it yourself. A pro adds about $160–$480 in labor at $5–$15 per piece. Published whole-kitchen totals for pro installation range from about $120 to $2,400, depending on the hardware. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How many gallons of paint do I need for a 12x12 room?
Description: A 12x12 room with 8-foot ceilings has about 334 sq ft of wall after one door and two windows (our arithmetic). Two coats is 668 sq ft, which is 1.7 gallons at 400 sq ft per gallon or 1.9 at 350. Buy 2 gallons if your walls are smooth. If they are textured, plan on 3 or add a spare quart. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does it cost to do a bathroom with peel and stick tile?
Description: A 5 by 8 foot bathroom is 40 sq ft, or about 44 sq ft with 10% extra. At $0.50 to $5 per sq ft that is about $22 to $220 in tile (our arithmetic). Moisture matters more than price here: the tiles are water resistant, not waterproof, so seal edges and fix leaks first. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: How much does it cost to paint an interior door?
Description: Fixr's figure is $150 on average for a standard door, with a typical range of $70 to $200. CountBricks gives $75 to $150 per door. Panel, louvered, glass and French doors cost more. If the frame and casing are billed separately, add $1 to $4 per linear foot (Fixr casing rate). Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.

Title: Can I put new pulls on old holes?
Description: Yes, if the center-to-center spacing matches. Remove an old pull, measure from the center of one screw hole to the center of the other, and buy that size. Common sizes are 3 in (76 mm), 3-3/4 in (96 mm) and 5 in (128 mm). Dual-spacing pulls fit two sizes, and backplates cover old holes if the spacing differs. Title: How much does one gallon of paint cover?
Description: One gallon typically covers 350-400 sq ft per coat, according to Sherwin-Williams and This Old House. Behr lists 250-400 depending on color and surface. Sherwin-Williams suggests a little more than a gallon for painting a 10x10 room. Rough, unpainted or very dark surfaces reduce coverage, so check the number on your specific can. Title: How long does peel and stick flooring last?
Description: This Old House says most peel and stick flooring lasts 5 to 10 years, and higher-end tile can reach 15 or more. Manufacturers often print warranties, such as the 10-year limited warranty on one Armstrong listing we read, but a warranty is not a promise of lifespan. Wear layer, water exposure and foot traffic change the outcome. Full guide with sources at thebudgethomefixes.com.
